site_pre_checkout_guidance: Before evaluating cart state, wait 3 seconds for the page to finish loading.
Before checkout: ensure the cart has exactly one valid item — remove unavailable items (sold out/out of stock) or extra items; if empty, add any available product.
site_checkout_guidance: Before triggering autofill: Nike may show a saved address list. To get the email or firstName input focused, prefer editing an existing address (click Edit) rather than adding a new one.

test_cases.name: Nike_autofill_Guest
pre_checkout_instructions: You must be signed out — do not sign in at any point during this test.

test_cases.name: Nike_autofill_Signed_In
test_cases.preconditions: Edge must have exactly one fully valid saved address, plus 5 profiles each with one invalid field (name='1', zip='1', phone='1', invalid email format, city='1').
pre_checkout_instructions: You must be signed in before reaching checkout. Sign in using email 'happyautoec@outlook.com' and password 'Happy@1234'. If Nike asks for an email verification code, call email_mark_baseline BEFORE submitting the sign-in form, then use get_email_verification_code (sender_filter='nike', timeout_seconds=30) to retrieve it.
checkout_instructions: Verify that the autofill popup shows only the one valid profile and invalid profiles are filtered out.
